heading: Abandonment of barge prohibited
lead: An owner or operator of a barge may not abandon it on the navigable waters of the United States. A barge is deemed not to be abandoned if—

tree.text: it is located at a Federally- or State-approved mooring area;
it is on private property with the permission of the owner of the property; or
the owner or operator notifies the Secretary that the barge is not abandoned and the location of the barge.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2006—Pub. L. 109–304 struck out subsec. (a) designation before “An owner”.
